Logs for admins and nicer tables.

### 🚀 Features
- **Logs page** in Settings for admins — server and app logs, with personal details scrubbed.
- Table controls are easier to read, and pasted tables sit on the note's paper.
- Embeds get their own toolbar.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.3.9...v0.3.10](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.3.9...v0.3.10)
